svg.title: 09. Supported squat stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Hold the rail. Stand with your feet a little wider than your hips. Bend both knees and lower into a comfortable squat. Keep your heels down and use your arms to control the depth.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.wchc.nhs.uk/services/pelvic-health/pelvic-stretches/
